answer: Under this PoA rule, verifiable equivocation among k coordinated, bonded identities incurs a pairwise penalty proportional to k(k−1)/2, hence O(k²). Detection also applies a defined exponential capital-loss multiplier m^k, for m>1, to the swarm’s slashable collateral; splitting stake across identities therefore does not dilute liability. Whether an identity is tagged terrace, dune, or vertex does not alter proof verification or enforcement.
